_text: [urgent, building] Ten steps. Twenty. THIRTY. Your stick stands in dry sand. [quick, excited] You see, the moon pulled the ocean up in a bump, like a hand lifting a *bedsheet*. Let go, and the sheet doesn't *slam*. It just... settles. [deadpan] The water stops. No wave. Just a slow, boring *tide*. [amused] And when it comes back, it stops a third of the way to your *stick*. Now only the sun is *pulling*. [dramatic] But the moon was also the world's biggest nightlight. Without it, nights get a hundred times *darker*. [amused] So Brad's floodlights are the brightest thing for fifty miles, and every moth for fifty miles finds BRAD. [amazed] Down on your dark beach, Mia looks up, and the sky is *exploding* with stars. [proud] The next night, four-thousand people bring a lawn chair.
